name: code
title: Code review
summary: Looks for code that gives wrong results, code nothing uses, missing handling of things going wrong, the same job done different ways, and shortcuts the code admits to.

categories.title: Wrong results
categories.description: Code that gives the wrong answer or does the wrong thing for some input.

categories.title: Missing handling of things going wrong
categories.description: Code that fails badly, or silently, when a file, a network call or an input is not what it expects.

categories.title: Code nothing uses
categories.description: Files, functions or settings that nothing in the project calls or reads any more.

categories.title: The same job done different ways
categories.description: Code that solves a problem the project already solves elsewhere, in a different way.

categories.title: Shortcuts the code admits to
categories.description: Shortcuts the code itself owns up to, such as TODO notes and temporary workarounds.

categories.title: Tests that do not check what they claim
categories.description: A test that passes whatever the code does, or checks the wrong thing.

exclude: Style, formatting and naming preferences, and missing comments.
Anything in a test file, unless the test itself is wrong.

severity.low: Untidy or confusing, but nothing goes wrong because of it.
severity.medium: Something goes wrong in an unusual case, or the next change here is likely to break something.
severity.high: Something goes wrong in normal use: wrong results, lost work or a crash.
severity.critical: Serious harm in normal use: lost or corrupted data, or money or trust lost.
